Class AlgoAlarmTextRenderer

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoAlarmTextRenderer
public class AlgoAlarmTextRenderer extends Object
Writes the text of an algo alarm notification in the language of its recipient.

The alarm details are stored as locale independent JSON (see AlgoAlarmDetails), because the language is only known when the notification is delivered. For every signal kind a headline key algo.alarm.<kind> names what happened, and a MessageFormat detail key turns the JSON fields into one sentence; numbers are formatted by the pattern of that key, and values that are keys themselves (action, reason, bound, direction, indicator) are translated first.

A notification is never lost because its text cannot be written: details that do not parse, or lack a field the sentence needs, are shown as they are stored.
